paras.en: (iii) The coefficient of correlation is independent of origin and scale i.e. r_xy = r_uv, where u = (x − a)/h and v = (y − b)/k.

paras.en: Correlation does not establish a cause and effect relationship between two variables. It does not provide any information about the size of the change in one variable as a result of a certain change in the other variable. In correlation both variables are interdependent. Relationship between them may be zero, weak or strong. Sometimes correlation between two unconnected variables will be nonsense or spurious.
